entities.name: UniProt O31809 YndE
observations: The submitted 363-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed Bacillus subtilis spore germination protein YndE (UniProt O31809).

YndE is annotated as a multi-pass cell-membrane protein involved in the germinative response to L-alanine; amino-acid transporter activity is proposed by similarity, not established here as a demonstrated substrate-specific transport function.
Sequence scan identifies the Spore_permease domain PF03845 at residues 7–329; reviewed reference annotation lists ten transmembrane helices.

entities.name: Spore germination
observations: UniProt O31809 YndE is associated with the spore germination process and L-alanine germinative response; exact biochemical mechanism is uncertain.
